thread:
emily (Design): quick UX check — in the trace/request drilldown the small 'export' link buried in the tooltip is getting complaints. thinking: move export to the header toolbar and keep the tooltip just for context + 'copy id'.

raj (Product): +1. header export is more discoverable. we still want a micro-affordance in the tooltip for power users. maybe a tiny kebab -> 'Export view' so it doesn't clutter the microcopy.

maria (Eng): note: header export will require capturing UI filters & time range server-side at export time. adds ~150-250ms backend work. ok if product expects that latency.

liam (A11y): a11y reminders: export control must have a descriptive aria-label (include id), be reachable by keyboard, and modal needs aria-modal/role=dialog. ensure focus management on open/close.

emily (Design): proposed concise tooltip copy: "Error context — top frames and request metadata. Expand to view stack or copy request id." Header CTA -> "Export trace" with small chevron for JSON/HAR. avoid 'snapshot'.

raj (Product): copy tweak: under export modal add microcopy: "Includes filters, time range, and visible stack frames." Default file = JSON. HAR optional.

maria (Eng): backend will attach small metadata blob (error class, sampling id, correlation id). HAR generation behind opt-in flag.

emily (Design): placement question: left next to Back or right near filters/time? vote: right near filters for consistency.

liam (A11y): visually right is fine, but DOM order should put export before overflow for keyboard nav. also ensure contrast meets 4.5:1.

raj (Product): propose keyboard shortcut Shift+E to open export modal and show in command palette.

maria (Eng): Shift+E okay, will scan for conflicts.

emily (Design): I'll update Figma and add a tiny 'copy id' inline link in tooltip. pushing screens now.

ui-bot: preview deployed at https://ui-stage.redwood.ai/trace-export-170445 — includes keyboard demo and JSON export.

raj (Product): thanks team — I'll update the copy doc and schedule a 15min sign-off tomorrow 9:30am.

emily (Design): works.

maria (Eng): works.

liam (A11y): I'll bring checklist and run quick contrast pass. :thumbsup:
